speech.heard: India, 27.4% of babies are born underweight, in Iceland it is 4%. India has the world's highest rate, a difficult start for newborns weighing less than 2500 grams. This counts weight within the first hour of life, before significant post-natal weight loss has occurred. India has 3.3 times the underweight newborns the USA has, where 8.3% of babies are underweight. Bangladesh 23% Philippines, 21.1% and Liberia, 19.9% are also high. Japan is a surprise for a wealthy nation, at 11.3%. At the other end, Sweden is just 4.1%. How common are underweight births where you live?
